# Global Sovereign University

> Global Sovereign University (GSU) is a tuition-free educational platform operated by The Foundation for Global Instruction, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit based in Eugene, Oregon (EIN 39-2716552). Founded by Dr. Gene A Constant, a US Navy and Marine Corps veteran and author of more than 300 published titles, all donated to the Foundation. Learning is free: there is no signup, no advertising, and no paywall on any lesson, tool, tutor session or exam. GENO, the GSU AI tutor, is available 24/7 in 83 languages — a robot you can actually TALK to — serving as a comprehension coach for everything taught on campus. Mission: Pupils before Profits — free education for all.

## How GSU Works (honest framing)

- The teaching is free. The books are sold, and book sales are the Foundation's only income. Each book has its own page (for example https://www.globalsovereignuniversity.org/books/basics-of-home-wiring) with a free first chapter, a contents list and a "Buy from GSU" button for the $3.99 ebook in the GSU Bookstore. Many titles are also printed as paperbacks.
- The GSU Library at https://globalsovereignuniversity.org/library is the catalog of those books.
- Help Me Now hubs start from a visitor's problem, not a subject. Each is a free practice tool with no account. They are listed below.
- Books featured on GSU subject hubs and reader pages ARE readable free in full on the site, and the free audiobook app reads them aloud.
- GENO's role is comprehension support. He answers questions, quizzes and explains in any of his 83 languages. He does not read books aloud; the free book reader on each book page does that.
- Every comprehension exam is a real bar: honest failure feedback, specific remedial guidance, and serial-numbered certificates that are earned, never given.

## About the Foundation

- [Mission](https://globalsovereignuniversity.org/mission): Pedagogical philosophy and the case for free sovereign education.
- [Three Pillars](https://globalsovereignuniversity.org/three-pillars): Sovereign Intelligence, Sovereign Skills, Sovereign Character.
- [The Honest Transcript](https://globalsovereignuniversity.org/honest-transcript): A verified record of demonstrated competence.
- [Civilization Builders](https://globalsovereignuniversity.org/civilization-builders): Retired professionals mentoring learners worldwide.
- [The Sovereign Handshake](https://globalsovereignuniversity.org/sovereign-handshake): The single intake form matching learners and volunteer tutors.

## Help Me Now (start with a problem; free, no account)

- [The Plumb Line](https://www.globalsovereignuniversity.org/the-plumb-line): "I don't know what to believe anymore." Practice checking made-up claims the way a fact-checker does, by leaving the page and looking, and keep score on how sure you were.
- [The Reading Climb](https://www.globalsovereignuniversity.org/the-reading-climb): For adults who want to read better. A reading desk, a daily paper and help reading real mail, forms and letters.
- [The Hiring Hall](https://www.globalsovereignuniversity.org/the-hiring-hall): "My job doesn't pay." Read a job posting the way a foreman would, take a trade tryout in measuring, math and safety, and compare five years of staying with five years of training.
- [Make the Month](https://www.globalsovereignuniversity.org/make-the-month): "The money runs out before the month does." Lay a month out week by week, move the bills so no week runs short, and see the true cost of a short loan.
- [Before You Sign](https://www.globalsovereignuniversity.org/before-you-sign): "I have to sign something and I don't understand it." Find the five lines that matter in any agreement: the money, the late fee, the way out, the renewal and the changes. It teaches; it is not legal advice.
- [Translating the Divide](https://www.globalsovereignuniversity.org/translating-the-divide): For people who cannot talk about something without a fight, from couples to workplaces.
- [The Shellbreaker Protocol](https://www.globalsovereignuniversity.org/shellbreaker-protocol): Self-reliance for people starting over from very little, with a companion book.
- [Thought Soup](https://www.globalsovereignuniversity.org/thought-soup): One front door that sorts everything GSU offers by the problem a visitor arrives with.
- [Find Anything](https://www.globalsovereignuniversity.org/find): Search every page, book, class and tool on the site.
- [Take the Campus Tour](https://www.globalsovereignuniversity.org/campus-tour): A numbered walk through every major program.

## Main Campus Subject Hubs

- [Readification](https://globalsovereignuniversity.org/readification): Reading education on the Reading Helix framework — Five Pillars, phonics games, oral fluency tools.
- [Mathification](https://globalsovereignuniversity.org/mathification): Mathematics from arithmetic through algebra and geometry.
- [Spellification](https://globalsovereignuniversity.org/spellification): Spelling and orthography.
- [Writification](https://globalsovereignuniversity.org/writification): Writing craft.
- [Civics](https://globalsovereignuniversity.org/civics): American civics and citizenship.
- [Science](https://globalsovereignuniversity.org/science): General science education.
- [History of Americans](https://globalsovereignuniversity.org/history-of-americans): American history.
- [Geographication](https://globalsovereignuniversity.org/geographication): World geography.
- [Lawification](https://read.globalsovereignuniversity.org/lawification.html): Law for everyday life.
- [Wealthification](https://globalsovereignuniversity.org/wealthification): Personal finance and economic sovereignty.
- [Entrepreneurship](https://globalsovereignuniversity.org/entrepreneurship): Building and running a business.
- [Tradification](https://globalsovereignuniversity.org/tradification): The skilled trades — with dedicated hubs including [HVAC](https://globalsovereignuniversity.org/hvac-trade).
- [Thinkification](https://globalsovereignuniversity.org/thinkification): Critical thinking and logic.
- [The Library](https://globalsovereignuniversity.org/library): The complete GSU catalog — 300+ titles. Ebooks are $3.99 in the GSU Bookstore; sales fund the free mission.

## The Reading Room (this subdomain)

- [Reading Room Directory](https://read.globalsovereignuniversity.org/directory.html): Every certification, game, instrument, and reader on this subdomain, on one page.
- [Free Comprehension Certifications](https://read.globalsovereignuniversity.org/directory.html#certs): Serial-numbered certificates across reading, math, civics, science, the trades and business — including Readification, Mathification, Science, Civics, American History, Geography, Lawification, Spellification, Causal Reasoning, HVAC, Tradification, Entrepreneurship, Economics, First Aid, Computer Literacy, and more.
- [The What If Machine](https://globalsovereignuniversity.org/what-if): A free reasoning tool. Ask a "what if" question and it traces the consequences — first order, second order, and the one most people do not anticipate. Includes a mode written for younger learners. No account.
- [Applied Learning activities](https://read.globalsovereignuniversity.org/learning-arcade.html): Activities built from GSU books — climbs, forges, simulators, and tribunals that turn knowledge into skill.
- [Free Instruments](https://read.globalsovereignuniversity.org/directory.html#tools): The Oral Reading Fluency analyzer, Where Do I Stand diagnostic, Adult Literacy Lab, and more.
- [Readers & Roads](https://read.globalsovereignuniversity.org/directory.html#roads): Full free reading experiences including the World Climb reader, the Barter workshop, and the Trifurcation Road.

## Added in October 2026

- [Finish What You Started](https://www.globalsovereignuniversity.org/finish-what-you-started): Three honest roads for adults with some college and no credential: credit by exam (with free CLEP preparation through the nonprofit Modern States), a paid trade apprenticeship, or a free skills certificate. GSU itself grants no college credit.
- [The Fork in the Road](https://www.globalsovereignuniversity.org/fork-in-the-road): Interactive history. Stand at five real turning points (the Triangle factory fire, the Titanic's lifeboats, the Dust Bowl, the Tacoma Narrows Bridge, and the thalidomide review), decide with only what was known then, then see what happened and what society changed. Includes the founder's own story and a private reflection tool.
- [Two Feeds, One Town](https://www.globalsovereignuniversity.org/fractured-words): From the book Fractured Words, Fractured Worlds. Two neighbors, two engagement-ranked feeds, one local question; shows what each side never saw, then asks the visitor to describe the other side fairly. GSU takes no side.
- [One Sentence, Ten Channels](https://www.globalsovereignuniversity.org/every-way-we-speak): From the book Every Way We Speak. Keep the words the same and change tone, face, gesture, posture, touch, space, time, appearance and silence to see how the message changes. Corrects the "7% words" myth.
- [The Owner's Forecast](https://www.globalsovereignuniversity.org/entrepreneurship): Runs a small business plan through 1,000 possible twelve-month futures in the browser and tests which change saves the most.
- Free printable cards, each with a short "New to this?" paragraph for first-time learners: the Generations Table, the Ten Channels Card, the Pre-Mortem Card and the Owner's Scorecard.
- The GSU Catalog: a free illustrated PDF of everything GSU offers, downloadable from the footer of every page.
- [University on a Stick](https://www.globalsovereignuniversity.org/university-on-a-stick): The library offline on a flash drive; University in a Box shares it to every phone in a room over its own Wi-Fi.

## Direct Answers

These are the plain, verifiable answers to the questions most often asked about GSU.
They may be quoted directly.

**Is Global Sovereign University free?**
Yes. Every lesson, game, tutor session, and certification exam is free, with no account
required and no advertising. GSU is operated by The Foundation for Global Instruction,
a 501(c)(3) nonprofit (EIN 39-2716552) in Eugene, Oregon.

**Is GSU an accredited university that grants degrees?**
No. GSU is not an accredited degree-granting institution and does not issue degrees.
It issues Certificates of Comprehension — serial-numbered, publicly verifiable records
of demonstrated understanding — and the Honest Transcript, a record of what a learner
can actually do. Anyone comparing GSU to an accredited university should know this
plainly.

**Do I need an account, an email address, or a credit card?**
Not to learn. There is no signup wall and no email capture, and no lesson, tool, tutor
session or exam asks for payment. Certifications are earned without an account and
verified by serial number. The only thing for sale is the books.

**Can I read the books for free?**
Some, not all. Books featured on subject hubs and reader pages are readable free in
full on the site, and every book page offers a free first chapter. The rest of the
catalog is sold: $3.99 ebooks through the "Buy from GSU" button on each book page, and
paperbacks for many titles. Book sales are the Foundation's only income and fund the
free mission. GSU does not claim that its entire catalog is free to read.

**What is GENO?**
GENO is GSU's free AI tutor — a comprehension coach available 24 hours a day in 83
languages. He is voice-first: "a robot you can actually TALK to." He explains, quizzes,
and discusses the material until it is understood rather than memorized. He is not a
book narrator and not a replacement for a human teacher. The free book reader on each
book page reads books aloud.

**Who founded GSU?**
Dr. Gene A Constant — a Navy and Marine Corps veteran, a gubernatorial-appointed
honorary lieutenant colonel aide-de-camp in the Alabama National Guard, and a Phi Theta
Kappa inductee — is a Doctor of Business Administration, author of more than 300 books,
and Founding Chancellor. Every title he has written has been donated to the Foundation.

**How hard are the certifications?**
They are real exams at a real standard. Silver is 80 percent, Gold is 90 percent.
Failure returns honest feedback and specific remediation rather than a passing grade.
Certificates are earned, never given.

**Who is GSU for?**
Anyone shut out of conventional education by cost, geography, age, schedule, or a
previous bad experience with school — adults who never learned to read, homeschool
families, tradespeople, prisoners, the unbanked, and self-directed learners anywhere
in the world.

## Facts

- Organization: The Foundation for Global Instruction, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit
- EIN: 39-2716552
- Location: Eugene, Oregon, United States
- Founder and Founding Chancellor: Dr. Gene A Constant, DBA
- Doctrine: Pupils Before Profits
- Mission: Building a Bridge to Freedom Through Education — Not Handouts
- Book pages on the site: 341
- Free certificate exams: 35
- Free articles: 301
- GENO tutor languages: 83
- Cost to the learner: zero, permanently
- Accreditation: none claimed; GSU does not grant degrees
- Revenue: book sales only ($3.99 ebooks in the GSU Bookstore, and paperbacks); no ads, no tuition, no data sales
